d:
Bihar men kheti ke sath-sath pashupalan gramin arthavyavastha ka majbut aadhar banta ja raha hai. gujrat men amul ne jis sahkari modal ke jarie dugdh kranti ki pahchan banaee, usi tarj par bihar men sudha dugdh kranti lane ki rah par hai. bihar ki 75% aabadi pratyaksh ya apratyaksh taur par krishi aur pashupalan par nirbhar hai aur pure purvottar bharat men sudha deyri agrani sthan hasil kar chuka hai.
